verdict.rationale: The evidence documents wire transfers only as transfers between accounts at different financial institutions, plus ACH, FedNow and book transfers. Nothing shows international or SWIFT wires, FX conversion with transparent rates, or a currency/corridor coverage map. A domestic wire is a related feature, not cross-border money movement, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a founder, money can cross borders — international wires or SWIFT, FX with transparent rates, and the coverage map of currencies and corridors documented
